cover.title: Freakonomics
cover.author: Steven D. Levitt & Stephen J. Dubner

segments.text: Your real estate agent swears she'll fight for every last dollar on your house. Then she sells her own house, same neighborhood, for more.
If she squeezes an extra ten thousand out of YOUR sale, her cut is about a hundred and fifty bucks. Not worth her weekend.
On her own house, that ten thousand is all hers. So she waits for the better offer. Same agent, opposite effort.
She didn't lie. She just knows how the game is really scored, and that gap is where your money leaks. Ask what your expert is paid to do.
